result.description: Intapp DealCloud is a CRM and deal-management platform for investment banks, PE and other financial-services firms.
result.auth_detail: REST API: each user creates an API key (client id + secret) in their Profile, then exchanges it via OAuth2 client-credentials at the tenant's /api/rest/v1/oauth/token for a 15-minute bearer token with scopes (data, user_management, publish, ri_import, backup). The MCP server uses separate per-user OAuth with discovery and no client id or secret.
result.access_detail: No public signup or free tier. Credentials only exist inside a customer's DealCloud tenant, so a customer admin must put the user in a group with the "API" site-area capability before that user can create a key. Docs do not state a plan restriction, but DealCloud is enterprise-licensed. The MCP server requires a "DealCloud with Celeste" license plus the Manage MCP Servers and MCP Access capabilities.
result.api_notes: Seven functional areas: Authentication, User Management, Schema, Data, Backups, Publications, Relationship Intelligence. The sidebar also lists Schema Contracts, Files, Merge, Template Reports, Cells, Rows, History and Delete. Each tenant exposes Swagger at https://{host}/swagger. The base URL is tenant-specific, so each user must supply their own host.
result.blocker: No self-serve developer access. Every user needs a licensed DealCloud tenant, an admin to enable API access, and their own tenant host URL. Toolkit testing needs a customer or partner sandbox. The MCP server is per-tenant and needs the Celeste license.

evidence.quote: Our APIs are organized into functional areas.
DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token
Tokens expire after 900 seconds (15 minutes) and must be refreshed by repeating the flow.
To enable API access, ensure the intended user is assigned to a user group with the appropriate permissions.
Each DealCloud site provides an interactive Swagger page for testing API calls.
DealCloud MCP uses OAuth to authenticate, letting AI assistants connect on behalf of an individual user.
DealCloud provides a default MCP Server out-of-the-box without any configuration required.
Every action and response honors individual users permissions.
